title: Notice on Luckycoin (LKY) Network Maintenance and Binance Pool LKY Mining Rewards Suspension - 2025-01-23
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, The  Luckycoin (LKY) network  will undergo a  hard fork at block 276,500 , at approximately  2025-01-23 12:00 (UTC) . The maintenance is expected to last  approximately 24 hours . LKY mining rewards distribution might be temporarily suspended. Mining rewards will resume once the hard fork is completed. Please note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Luckycoin (LKY) is not currently listed (tradable) on Binance.com. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-01-23
